subject: USAGE clause
notes: LANDED 2026-08-18 (kb/Work PB95, found landing PB79): `[USAGE IS] usage-keyword` is ONE alternative over ONE usageKeyword rule - the USAGE keyword is optional for EVERY usage. RE-VERDICTED by kb/Work PB848 (this verdict had stood while the format was violated): on the RENDERED folio 503 TO is not underlined in `POINTER [ TO type-name-1 ]`, `FUNCTION-POINTER TO function-prototype-name-1` or `PROGRAM-POINTER [ TO program-prototype-name-1 ]`, and OF is not underlined in OBJECT REFERENCE's `[ FACTORY OF ]` - all four were REQUIRED by the grammar. Now `KEYWORD (TO cobolWord | {pointerOperandHere()}? cobolWord)?` and `(FACTORY OF?)?`; the TO-less operand's clause-swallow guard is the ATN FIRST set of dataDescriptionClause. The binder reads the operand's presence, never TO's. RE-VERDICTED by kb/Work PB3517 (this verdict again stood while the format was violated, the other direction): the clause's four optional phrases are parsed after EVERY usage word, and the SIGNED / UNSIGNED phrase, which folio 503 prints only after BINARY-CHAR/-SHORT/-LONG/-DOUBLE (SIGNED not underlined, UNSIGNED underlined), was never narrowed, so `USAGE COMP UNSIGNED` compiled clean with the word ignored. Which usage each phrase may follow is now ONE table, UsagePhraseRules (SIGNED/UNSIGNED COBOL4733, WITH NO SIGN COBOL1565, endianness-phrase COBOL1716, encoding-phrase COBOL1717), read by ONE method, DataBinder.ScreenUsagePhrases; UsageClausePhraseDriftTests checks the table against the printed figure for every grammar usage word.
